entries.title: Track jobs at a glance
entries.description: The refreshed job list makes workflow stages, machine activity, items needing review, and job values easier to scan. Each machine now has a timeline showing its assignment, arrival, departure, and measures.

entries.title: Capture arrivals and departures with clearer forms
entries.description: Update the implement and driver while capturing arrival, then save them with the reading. Drag in a meter photo, preview or enlarge it before saving, and see a clear prompt when departure needs a photo or reason.

entries.title: Review readings alongside their evidence
entries.description: Reading dialogs separate the recorded hours and meter photo from the AI assessment, with actions to correct a reading or recheck its photo. Foremen can now view meter photos attached to their assigned jobs.

entries.title: Manage charges directly in pricing
entries.description: Pricing now groups machine assignments, charge lines, and adjustments separately. Add or edit charge descriptions and amounts in place, and keep the value you entered when switching between rand and percentage discounts.

entries.title: Distinguish cancellations from warnings
entries.description: Cancelled items now use red status badges.

entries.title: Use simpler control styling
entries.description: Focused fields, buttons, and other controls no longer show extra highlight rings. Validation errors remain highlighted.

entries.title: Recognise machine status at a glance
entries.description: Machine cards now use coloured badges to distinguish planned machines, machines on site, machines that have left, and captures needing attention.
